consent.noticeTitle: May the cal.com booking calendar load?
consent.noticeText: This website sets no cookies for analytics or advertising. For online booking we embed the calendar of cal.com (Cal.com, Inc., USA). When it loads, your browser sends your IP address, among other data, to cal.com in the USA, and cal.com sets a cookie to fend off automated access. This only happens with your consent.
consent.noticeChoice: Without consent the website works in full, and you arrange your appointment by telephone or email instead. You can change or withdraw your choice at any time under Cookie settings at the bottom of every page.
consent.necessaryText: Stores your choice in this browser (localStorage, entry tg-consent with the version of the notice, the time and your choice), so we do not ask again. No identifier, read only by this website. No consent required under § 25(2) no. 2 TDDDG (German Telecommunications Digital Services Data Protection Act).
consent.bookingText: Loads the booking calendar of Cal.com, Inc., San Francisco, USA, on the home page and the booking page as soon as it comes into view. cal.com then receives your IP address, details of your browser and device, and the address of the page. Its service provider Cloudflare sets the cookie __cf_bm against automated access (30 minutes), and technical error reports go to Sentry. Transfer to the USA is based on the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework. The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR, § 25(1) TDDDG), which you can withdraw here at any time. Without it the calendar stays off, and appointments are available by telephone or email.
